question: What is the meaning of add-ons in relation to system information?
description: Add-ons refer to optional modules or topics that can be inserted into a Product Declaration System (PCDS) template according to the requirements of this clause. These add-ons provide additional information about the product, such as its material inputs, durability, and extended lifetime. They are not mandatory but can be included to support customers in sustainable procurement, product lifetime extension, and end-of-life trajectories.
